title: RatioAvis: Guided least-cost diet formulation for broiler chickens
description: Bilingual (Spanish/English) single-file web application for least-cost broiler diet formulation by linear programming (two-phase simplex with duality optimality certificate). Includes genetic lines (Ross 308, Arbor Acres Plus, Cobb 500, Hubbard Efficiency Plus, slow-growing birds, NRC 1994, custom profile), production conditions, editable ingredient library, multiphase feeding program, reports and validation against published diets.
